# Question 1
```{r}
# Create a function in R

summary_stats<-function(x) {
  results <- c(
    count = length(x),
    Mean = mean(x),
    Median = median(x),
    Minimum = min(x),
    Maximum = max(x),
    Variance = var(x),
    Standard_Deviation = sd(x)
  )
  return(results)
}

# Create a variable containing students marks

students_marks <- c(60, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95)

# now we Applying the function to the variable
summary_stats(students_marks)
```
